digest.component_or_area: CLI core execution and dispatch router
propositions: Top-level CLI execution must dispatch through a single validated registry route after help boundary, resolving only the selected lazy handler and invoking it through a closed typed adapter set, without re-parsing command or nested options.

Registry-derived mount eligibility, initialization policies (none/init_only/full), and confirmation/output extraction must match pre-cutover behavior for every route including no-auto-mount and conditional selectors.
Confirmation, global output extraction, legacy JSON shapes, token preservation after --, streams, exit codes, and exception propagation must be behaviorally equivalent to existing implementations.
Bridge compatibility spellings execute through approved adapters (argv prefix) while purge-bridge remains unknown; hidden bridge-status must use the argv adapter.
Every core and bridge route must carry exactly one lazy handler with one closed adapter kind, with only the selected handler and parser modules imported during execution.
